text: Offer pasupu, kumkuma and gandham to the vigraham.
If you have vigrahas at home, you may dress them with gandham, pasupu, kumkuma and akshatalu, in your family's own way.
If you have photographs, though, there is no need to wipe off yesterday's gandham or kumkuma and put it on afresh every single day.
Let them stay as they are — carry today's puja on, easily.
Whenever you feel like cleaning the photographs and offering fresh gandham or kumkuma, you may.
Nitya puja does not mean doing everything from the beginning every day.
It means carrying on with devotion, as easily as you can.
